system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, focus more on the technological side of their craft, modifying their Shinobi Instrument in ways to augment their combat capabilities. This branch focuses on putting pressure on your foes through brutal close or mid-range combat. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight far above your weight class.

Rather than a combat stance, when initiative is rolled, you tune your Shinobi Instrument to build Resonance. Resonance is represented as vibrational buildup your Shinobi Instrument has accumulated from your attacks. You begin combat with 0 Resonance, and can gain 1 Resonance, per turn, when you make an attack with your Shinobi Instrument or a Taijutsu (or Bukijutsu) while wielding your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can store up to 4 Resonance. You can only gain Resonance in combat. Resonance last for 1 minute or until your release a Menacing Melody or Combat ends. You begin with 3 such Melodies. If a Melody requires a saving throw it uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Vertigo Strike. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance, to force the target creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Disorientation.

Frenetic Frequency. When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a Melee attack while you are wielding your Shinobi Instrument, you can, as a reaction spend 2 Resonance, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they take 2d8 psychic damage, and gain 2 ranks of Concussed. This increases by +2d8 at 7th and 15th levels.

Overtone Burst. Once per turn, when you deal damage as a result of a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you cast with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance to either reduce the targets DR by 4 or remove one of the following resistances (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Earth, Lighting, Psychic, or Force), until the end of your next turn.
